title: Harnessing solid-state technology for next-generation iron–air batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01224K, Review Article

Bingqian Sun, Hao Wang, Cheng Peng
Iron–air batteries represent a promising candidate for large-scale energy storage due to their sustainable advantages. Solid-state design is a crucial strategy for enhancing the performance of iron–air batteries.
